body:
Adds `research/delayed-routing`: fixed-rate Hedge (= LMSR) routing of modular experts when feedback arrives after device-dependent delays.

- Regret bound `ln N/η + ηT/8 + ηD/2` with a short proof, checked on random sequences and against an adaptive adversary
- Experiments: bound tightness, delay-blind vs delay-tuned rates, heterogeneous fleets, an adaptive rate from observable counts, and LMSR subsidy scaling
- 11 stdlib-only tests, white paper, portfolio page and README entries
